sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach's recent form shows a mixed picture—they suffered a loss in their most recent outing but have been strong overall this season, with seven wins, one draw, and just two defeats. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with only four points from ten games and are in very poor form, making them vulnerable opponents for the league leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides looking to improve after recent losses. AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger teams—Bridgnorth have shown recent wins but did lose their last two games, while Eccleshall sit fifth and are on a winning run. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a Wolverhampton derby that sees the Casuals on good form (W-W-W) versus Wednesfield, who have also won their last two. In-form Bilston Town (five wins from eight games) travel to face Foley Meir, who are struggling with just three wins from eight matches. Crewe's poor form continues as they host mid-table Allscott Heath; New Mills entertain Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two sides with inconsistent recent records. Shawbury United are in freefall with six consecutive losses and host Barnton, who are on a small uptick after wins in their last two. Brereton Social, also enduring difficult form, host Widnes Town—the division's basement club with just two points from seven games—on Saturday before facing Wednesfield Community again on Wednesday evening.
